root.label: Administrative Law Judge reduces Damien Shanklin Title IX punishment

events.label: Administrative Law Judge reduces Damien Shanklin Title IX punishment

slots.name: suspension length
slots.sentence: The Title IX investigation found Shanklin responsible for "forcible rape," which resulted in a one-year suspension from all campus activities.

slots.name: ruling date
slots.sentence: Shanklin appealed it and in August, Administrative Law Judge Janet Waguespack reduced the punishment to a probation that allowed Shanklin to remain enrolled and able to participate in activities.
